description:
> Lean In Hacks is an **annual flagship hackathon of Lean In IGDTUW** - the first chapter of Lean In India. 


Lean In Hacks is a **beginner-friendly hackathon** and has a place for everyone wanting to learn, build, share, and grow in their lives through their unique ideas.

Our hackathon journey started in 2020 when we conducted the first edition of Lean In Hacks to give grounds to new thoughts and tools to animate the imaginative and critical thinking side of developers. 

This time, **hackers from any college** can participate in our hackathon, which will be held in **hybrid mode**. The only requirement is to have **at least 1 female in your team**!

Hackers will be given the **weekend to build their product online** and the **top teams will be given a chance to pitch in the offline mode**.

**Themes**:
1. Open Innovation
2. Sustainable Development Goals
3. Emerging Technologies


As a beginner-friendly hackathon, we offer a dedicated **Beginner’s Track** exclusively for first-time hackers. This track is designed as an **ideathon** for **first-year students**, aimed at fostering innovative thinking, creativity, and confidence in problem-solving.

hackathon_faqs.answer:
1. Each team should have 1 to 4 members.
2. Each member should currently be enrolled in a university program.
3. Team Members can be from any year and any program.
4. The hackathon is open to all, but each team should comprise a **minimum of 1 female member**. (Eg: In a team of 4 people, at least 1 members should be female)
5. Intercollege Teams are allowed.
6. Inter-specialization team members are allowed.
